;Law and crime
*A French man is detained in [[Barcelona]], [[Spain]], upon entering the [[Sagrada Familia]] with a suitcase containing ammunition. The [[Mossos d'Esquadra|Catalan police]] do not consider it an act of [[terrorism]]. [https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/barcelona-security-alert-after-man-13795520 (''Mirror'')]
;Politics and elections
*[[2018 Bangladeshi general election]]
**Voters in [[Bangladesh]] head to the polls to elect 299 [[Jatiya Sangsad|representatives to parliament]]. Seventeen people were killed in deadly clashes between supporters and opponents of the country's ruling party. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-46603113 (BBC)]
**The [[Awami League]] led by [[Sheikh Hasina]] is declared as the winner of the election with Hasina to serve her third consecutive term as [[Prime Minister of Bangladesh]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-46718393 (BBC)]
*[[2018 Democratic Republic of the Congo general election]]
**Voters in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] head to the polls to determine a successor to incumbent [[President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|President]] [[Joseph Kabila]]. Elections are also held for the [[National Assembly (Democratic Republic of the Congo)|National Assembly]] and local councils. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-46712759 (BBC News)] [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/12/30/democratic-republic-congo-vote-troubled-election/ (''The Telegraph'')]
